# hayhost

> hayhost is a booking website and hotel management system for small hotels and homestays in Thailand. The service is in Thai and English.

hayhost is made for small property owners who take direct bookings. It keeps rooms, bookings and guest details in one place.

## What it does

- A booking website for each hotel, with rooms, photos and available dates
- One calendar for arrivals, departures and available rooms
- Guest details prepared for the TM.30 report to Thai immigration
- Housekeeping status for each room
- Staff accounts with separate permissions

## Links

- [Home](https://www.hayhostth.com/): what hayhost does and common questions
- [Sign up](https://www.hayhostth.com/signup): create an account and a hotel
